task.title: Change a person
task.shortdesc: Correct a name, a date or a place on a person's page, add another name, or remove a person.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the page and choose .

stepresult.p: The page turns into a form. It may open part of the way down, so scroll up to see the names.

info.p: To record another name, choose under . Choose a such as or . Then type the names. explains the kinds.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the form. Choose to keep your changes, or to leave the form as it was.

stepresult.p: The page shows the new words. If you cancel after a change, a box asks if you want to discard it.

result.p: The button sits below . It removes the person, and takes them out of any family or event. A box names the person and asks you to check. You cannot undo it, so check before you choose .
